title: He Leadeth Me
lyrics: What-[C]e'er I do, wher-[F]e'er I be,
[C]He leadeth me, O [F]blessed thought! O [C]words with heavenly comfort [G]fraught!
What-[C]e'er I do, where-[F]'er I be Still [C]'tis God's hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]Sometimes mid scenes of [F]deepest gloom, some[C]times where Eden's bowers [G]bloom,
by [C]waters still, o'er [F]troubled sea, still [C]'tis his hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]Lord, I would place my [F]hand in thine, nor [C]ever murmur nor re[G]pine;
con[C]tent, whatever [F]lot I see, since [C]'tis my God that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]And when my task on [F]earth is done, when [C]by thy grace the victory's [G]won,
e'en [C]death's cold wave I [F]will not flee, since [C]God through Jordan [G]leadeth [C]me.
